cases.title: every rawscript, depth first, then failure and preprocessor

files.f/x.flow/flow.yaml:
value:
  modules:
    - id: loop
      value:
        type: forloopflow
        iterator: {type: static, value: [1]}
        modules:
          - id: inner
            value: {type: rawscript, language: bun, content: '!inline inner.ts', input_transforms: {}}
    - id: br
      value:
        type: branchone
        branches:
          - expr: 'true'
            modules:
              - id: b1
                value: {type: rawscript, language: bun, content: '!inline b1.ts', input_transforms: {}}
        default:
          - id: d1
            value: {type: rawscript, language: bun, content: '!inline d1.ts', input_transforms: {}}
  failure_module:
    id: failure
    value: {type: rawscript, language: bun, content: '!inline failure.ts', input_transforms: {}}
  preprocessor_module:
    id: preprocessor
    value: {type: rawscript, language: bun, content: '!inline preprocessor.ts', input_transforms: {}}
